news.title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
ALTK-Evolve: How learned memory tops the τ²-bench leaderboard on customer service tasks without a frontier model
AnyLanguageModel 1.0 统一 Apple 平台本地与托管模型接口
news.body: 项目介绍统一会话接口及 Swift 模型下载组件，可在系统、本地开放权重和托管模型之间选择。各后端的功能、系统版本和资源需求仍有差异，不能将接口统一视为所有模型能力相同。
news.title_original: AnyLanguageModel 1.0: One Year of Local Models on Apple Platforms

news.title: Hugging Face 团队介绍 PyTorch 2.15 的 MPS 改进
news.body: 文章讨论 Apple 芯片上的 FP8 支持、解码路径和 Metal 内核改进。功能依赖兼容系统、Python 与硬件，实际性能应按模型和负载测试，不能把单项优化外推为统一加速。

news.title: MIT 用对称性模型辅助运动中胎儿 MRI 重建
news.body: 报道介绍 E(3)-Pose 通过学习空间变换帮助处理胎动造成的切片错位，供放射科医生查看更清晰图像。研究展示不等于临床诊断已获普遍验证，也不能替代医生评估。
news.title_original: Why teaching AI about symmetry could make prenatal diagnosis more reliable
news.body_original: A model developed by researchers at MIT and Boston Children's Hospital adjusts scans on the fly to track fetal movement, potentially sparing families repeat hospital visits.

news.title: OpenAI 报告低资源编程语言构建与迁移评测进展
news.body: 研究以多语言数据库实现和 COBOL 迁移测试衡量模型能力，强调保持原程序行为。基准结果限于所测任务，生产迁移仍需专家审查、业务规则核验和充分测试。
news.title_original: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
news.body_original: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.

news.title: TorchNeuron 公测将 Trainium 接入原生 PyTorch 工作流
news.body: 文章介绍原生设备后端、即时执行及分布式接口，并说明 Hugging Face 库的集成。项目处于公测，兼容性和实际性能需结合版本、模型与硬件验证。
news.title_original: TorchNeuron: running HF models on AWS Trainium is easier than ever

news.title: MIT 用结构与语言结合改进 AI 对材料的描述
news.body: 报道介绍多模态模型将三维原子结构与自然语言信息结合，利用实验文献和第一性原理数据库描述材料的性质、加工与用途。方法旨在缓解文本训练和材料数据偏差，不能据此认为任意需求都能直接得到已验证的新材料。
news.title_original: Giving AI a “crystal clear” view of the materials world
news.body_original: New research can help AI models understand crystalline materials in 3D and reason about their properties.

news.title: Itaú 如何面向全体客户构建生成式 AI
news.body: 仅根据已有来源标题翻译。原文当前无法访问，未核验正文，不沿用此前案例细节。
news.title_original: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
news.body_original: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

news.title: Google 探索将 AI 智能体与湿实验机器人结合
news.body: 研究介绍把智能体连接到实验机器人，通过真实读数反馈开展分子设计循环，并报告特定蛋白结合物研究结果。文章也指出模型对三维几何与物理状态推理仍不可靠；自动化实验进展不等于药物已获临床验证。
news.title_original: Grounding AI agents in biological reality: Building blocks for autonomous wet labs

news.title: MIT 报道 Kendall Square 创新活动中的社区与劳动议题
news.body: 活动汇集企业、居民与研究人员，讨论 AI 如何帮助劳动者扩展能力，以及创新与社区的关系。报道呈现演讲和交流观点，不是关于就业影响的因果研究。
news.title_original: Fostering community amid Kendall Square’s innovation
news.body_original: The 18th annual Kendall Square Association Annual Meeting explored how new technologies could be a force for shared prosperity in society.

news.title: NVIDIA 与 AI4Bharat 介绍印度语言预训练数据生成方案
news.body: 文章预告覆盖 22 种印度语言的大规模语料及开放 GPU 数据生成管线，包含翻译、质量检查与修复流程。来源称数据即将发布，不能写成已全部开放；规模也不等于所有语言质量已独立验证。
news.title_original: Scaling Indic Pretraining: 2.8 Trillion Tokens and an Open Data Generation Pipeline

news.title: Benefit Street Partners 分享用 Codex 加快问题解答的案例
news.body: 客户案例介绍把 AI 编码与内部工作需求结合，以帮助人员更快获取和分析信息。案例经验不代表独立准确率评估，也不能据此推断投资回报或省略对输出的核验。
news.title_original: Benefit Street Partners answers questions faster with Codex
news.body_original: Anant Kumar builds tools to compare loan valuations and analyze credit agreements, using Codex for code review and faster follow-ups.

news.title: Stack Overflow 分享通过 ChatGPT 插件扩展智能体服务的案例
news.body: 客户案例讨论将 Stack Overflow for Agents 与 ChatGPT 插件连接，以及注册量变化。增长指标来自企业报告，不能把注册量直接当作持续使用、收入增长或答案质量提升。
news.title_original: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
news.body_original: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10× growth in agent creation.

papers.title: 微调机器学习势探索金刚石缺陷形成路径
papers.body: arXiv:2610.26301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diamond is an important host material for functional defects such as solid-state spin qubits. During the defect creation by irradiation and subsequent thermal annealing, carbon-related defects, including vacancies and interstitials, are generated and can migrate to form new defect complexes. To investigate this kinetically driven process and reveal the formation mechanisms of the di-interstitials and di-vacancies in the neutral charge state, we fine-tuned a universal machine learning interatomic potential using a small dataset generated from density functional theory calculations. We obtained a barrier of 1.84 eV for mono-interstitial migration

papers.body: arXiv:2610.26701v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Foundation machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) promise broad transferability, yet their out-of-domain reliability is hard to establish. Here, we use pure and O/H-containing disordered carbon spanning multiple phases, competing hybridisations and porous frameworks to stress-test six popular foundation MLIPs. We first screen all six on density functional theory (DFT) energy and force errors and binding curves, then subject four to melt-quench-anneal molecular dynamics and evaluate the resulting structural observables. papers.body: arXiv:2604.27775v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Shallow nanoindentation, needed for thin layers, individual phases and small volumes, gives hardness inflated by the indentation size effect (ISE). The Nix-Gao correction reduces this inflation but requires deep indentations of the same material, often impossible in such samples. We present a data-efficient workflow, trained on a few reference materials, that predicts a high-load reference hardness from a single shallow indentation. papers.body: arXiv:2609.26502v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Deep generative models are widely reported to enable de novo crystal structure prediction (CSP), but their capability has not been measured consistently against template-based methods. We evaluate 12 representative generative CSP models, spanning latent-variable, diffusion, flow-matching, autoregressive, and manifold random-walk architectures, against TCSP 2.0 on 180 test structures and a leakage-controlled subset of 46. All methods use identical structure-matching, symmetry, and consensus criteria.
